branding.title: Branding
branding.intro: Make the management app and the screens visitors see look like your own: your name, logo, colours and fonts.
branding.identity.title: Name and logo
branding.identity.hint: Shown in the menu, the browser tab and the sign-in screen, and on every site's passcode, not-found and error screens unless a site has its own.
branding.identity.siteHint: Shown on this site's passcode, not-found and error screens. Leave a field as it is to keep the server's.
branding.identity.name: Name
branding.identity.signInMessagePlacehold: Use your company account to sign in.
branding.identity.signInMessageHint: One line under the sign-in heading, in your own words. It is not translated.
branding.identity.logoHasName: The logo includes the name, so show the logo alone
branding.identity.imageHint: SVG, PNG, WebP, JPEG, GIF or ICO, up to {size} KB. An SVG stays sharp at every size. With no dark logo, the light one is used on dark colours too.
branding.starter.title: Start from a theme
branding.starter.hint: Fills in every colour, font and size below. Nothing changes until you save.
branding.colors.title: Colours
branding.colors.hint: Each colour has a value for light colours and one for dark. People see the one their system or their choice in the menu asks for.
branding.colors.contrastHint: Body text needs a contrast of at least 4.5:1 with what is behind it, and links and buttons 3:1. Low contrast is hard to read for many people.
branding.type.title: Fonts and sizes
branding.type.fontsHint: A system font looks native on each device and needs no download. Chinese, Japanese and Korean text always uses the device's own fonts for the characters a font lacks.
branding.form.saved: Saved the branding. Pages that are open show it after a reload.
branding.preview.title: Preview
branding.preview.hint: Forward paths on this site to other servers.
branding.fonts.title: Font library
branding.fonts.hint: Fonts the branding can use, served from this server unless one is loaded from Google. Removing a font that is in use puts the system font back.
branding.fonts.empty: The library has no fonts yet. Upload one, or allow Google Fonts and add one.
branding.fonts.sample: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog
branding.fonts.source.googleOff: Google Fonts are not allowed, so it is not used
branding.fonts.removeConfirm: Remove {family} from the library? Branding that uses it goes back to the system font.
branding.fonts.removed: Removed {family}. Branding that used it uses the system font again.
branding.fonts.notFound: That font is no longer in the library.
branding.fonts.upload.title: Upload a font
branding.fonts.upload.hint: WOFF2 works best; WOFF, TTF and OTF work too, up to {size} MB each. Name each file for its weight, such as `BrandSans-Bold.woff2` or `BrandSans-600-Italic.woff2`: this server reads the weight and style from the name.
branding.fonts.upload.noFiles: Choose at least one font file.
branding.fonts.upload.tooLarge: {file} is larger than {size} MB, the most a font file can be.
branding.fonts.added: Added {family} to the library, with {files}. Choose it under **Fonts and sizes**.
branding.fonts.addedLinked: Added {family} to the library. Pages load it from Google. Choose it under **Fonts and sizes**.
branding.google.title: Google Fonts
branding.google.offHint: Off on this server. While it is off, no page loads anything from Google, and fonts are uploads or the system's own.
branding.google.onHint: Allowed on this server. Each font from Google is either downloaded once and served from here, so visitors' browsers never contact Google, or loaded from Google by each browser.
branding.google.disallowConfirm: Stop allowing Google Fonts? Fonts loaded from Google stop being used; downloaded ones keep working.
branding.google.allowed: Google Fonts are allowed. Add one below.
branding.google.disallowed: Google Fonts are no longer allowed. Fonts loaded from Google are not used; downloaded ones still are.
branding.google.familyHint: As fonts.google.com writes it, capital letters included, such as `Inter`, `Source Serif 4` or `Noto Sans SC`.
branding.google.downloadHint: Visitors' browsers never contact Google, which suits privacy rules such as the GDPR. A Chinese, Japanese or Korean font downloads as many small pieces, so a page still fetches only the characters it shows.
branding.google.linkHint: Nothing is stored here, but every visitor's browser contacts Google for the font.
